reference_sql:
SELECT year(launch_date) AS launch_year,
       COUNT(*) AS products
FROM products
WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
GROUP BY year(launch_date)
alternatives: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM launch_date) AS launch_year, COUNT(product_id) AS products FROM products WHERE year(launch_date) >= 2020 GROUP BY 1
SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM launch_date) AS launch_year, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2020-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(year FROM launch_date)

other_way.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM launch_date) AS launch_year, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2020-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(year FROM launch_date)
other_way.tradeoff: EXTRACT(year FROM d) is the standard, portable spelling of the same part, but year(d) is shorter to read and write.
